description: Cisco Talos reputation for one public IPv4 address: threat level (favorable, neutral, poor, untrusted), web reputation score, forward/reverse DNS match, hostname, owner, location, email volume magnitude (daily, monthly and last 30 days), and how Talos rates the other addresses in the same /24. Use it to judge mail or web traffic coming from an address; for a yes/no blocklist hit use security_spamhaus_zen, for user-reported abuse use security_abuseipdb_check. When Talos's full IP report is unavailable, the answer carries its web reputation only (threat level, categories, the rules that fired, e.g. tri_tor_exi for a Tor exit) and says so in detail. Private, loopback and multicast addresses are refused with 400 and not charged. Read-only, one address per call. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
